description: This Java source file defines the `ResourceNotModifiableException` class, a custom exception used in the Eclipse Ditto project. It indicates that a resource within a policy could not be modified due to insufficient permissions. The class includes metadata, constants, constructors, factory methods, and a builder pattern for creating instances.
